verdict.rationale: Puzzle publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.3 document at app.puzzle.io/rest/v0/openapi.yaml that downloads unauthenticated, so the core capability exists. Discoverability is weak: the spec URL is not linked from any docs page, the ReadMe download button is admin-gated, and probes of the help domain's standard OpenAPI paths returned 404. Those probes checked a different domain, so they do not contradict the vendor's claim. Missing for 10: a documented or prose-linked public download path, a working self-serve download button on the developer reference, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the spec downloads.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Puzzle publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.3 document (info title "Puzzle Api", server https://app.puzzle.io/rest/v0) on its app domain
